subject: Air freight quote to ORD
body:
Hello,

Could you please quote your cheapest air freight option to ORD (Chicago, US) for 6 pieces of precision instruments? The total gross weight is 679 kg and the volume is 4.19 cbm.

The shipment will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-28 at our site in 51896 (Bergisch Gladbach), Germany. Please arrange the truck from our site to the departure airport and include this in your all-in price in EUR.

Thank you.

Viele Gruesse / Many greetings
Deniz Yilmaz
Rheintal Elektronik GmbH
